{{Quote|Protocol droid, tell me what this imbecile is babbling on about!|An IG-100 MagnaGuard to C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
A '''[[Bith/Legends|Bith]]''' served [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When he saw two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the bar of Ziro's Palace he ran off to alert a palace guard. He managed to find an [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]], but the Magnaguard could not understand the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] the Bith was speaking. The Magnaguard found the [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and ordered Threepio to translate for the Bith. Since Threepio did not want the Jedi to be [[Death/Legends|killed]], he told the guard false translations. The guard lost his temper and killed the Bith.
